title: 01 · Payments table · Quoin
strengths: Reads as a shipped payments console: status tiles that add up (2,291 + 61 + 4 + 3 + 59 = 2,418) and act as quick filters, chips that show their values ('Currency | USD, EUR, GBP'), '2,418 results · times in EDT (UTC−4)', 36 px rows on hairlines
Ledger amounts: right-aligned tabular digits, cents and currency code muted, three currencies and four bank rails, mono IDs ('qpy_3NfT8kQ2aXwL'), failed amounts struck through
Restraint in status: the normal 'Succeeded' state is a quiet ✓ with no fill, so Uncaptured, Refunded and the one amber Disputed badge stand out; the × on 'Failed 3' is the only red on screen
The bulk bar leads with the count and the selection's sum ('3 selected $21,162.82 USD'), and the column popover has Fixed / Shown / Hidden groups, drag handles and 'Saved to this view'
slop_signals: Every transient state is staged at once: the 'Edit columns' popover is open over the Created and Payment ID columns while three rows are selected and the bulk bar ('3 selected $21,162.82 USD') covers the last rows. Stripe and Attio show one transient at a time
The popover hides the two columns that prove the data is real (Created, mono Payment ID) in the hero frame
The customer list does not belong to one business: a 'retailer' (notes) billing 'Retainer · October', 'Subscription · Growth', 'Membership · 12 seats' and dental groups
Signed-in avatar 'MO' (Mira Okafor) is the same initials and look as the avatars in Fennick and Sounding
fixes: Close the column popover in the main frame (keep it as a second state) so the Created and ID columns read; keep the bulk bar
Make the uncaptured EUR row a card payment, not SEPA Direct Debit
Give Tamsin & Rowe one business model and write descriptions that fit it, or call it a platform whose customers are mixed

Rename reused names: Tidewell Marine Supply (Kilnworks' workspace is Tidewell Analytics), Kovač Structural (hero's Mirela Kovač), Calder & Voss (hero's Calder Inn), Juniper & Pell (components/08 Juniper Static), Mira Okafor

references.what: Same structure (count tiles, chips, Edit columns with fixed columns). Ours matches it and has quieter status; theirs shows one transient at a time
Selection with a total in the footer ('Pay selected'), heavier red overdue status; ours is calmer
Filter chips with values and 'Showing 1 to 1 of 1'; ours is denser and more exact

facts: Fresh audit nice-to-haves not done: the Maison Delacroix Traiteur cell (row 19, below the fold in every frame) is 2 px short; Oct 12 was Columbus Day, so banks settled on 9 of the 10 working days
engine.py review lists 89 raw values (88 px sizes, 1 shadow): spacing is written in px, as before the rework
Penwarden Hotels' empty frame is the only place the 12-receipt figures appear; they are internally consistent ($18,210.20 + $212.40 = $18,422.60)
check_dates.py --year 2026: every weekday matches; weekdays inside the script data were checked by hand (Oct 13 Tuesday, Oct 14 Wednesday)
fixed: Main frame keeps one temporary state (three rows selected with the bulk bar); the Edit columns popover moved to shot-columns.png (?state=columns), with nothing selected and no hover row, so the Created and Payment ID columns read
Uncaptured is now only on card payments: the SEPA DD row (and an ACH row also marked Uncaptured) are card orders

Tamsin & Rowe is now a wholesale supplier of tableware and kitchen equipment; all 40 customers are restaurants, hotels, caterers, cafés and venues, and descriptions are only 'Order …' or 'Invoice …' (no retainers, subscriptions or seat memberships)
Rows fit the counts: 2,418 payments in 7 days is about 15 an hour, so the 40 rows are now the last two hours (Oct 14, 09:00-11:02 EDT) instead of two and a half days

Statuses fit that timing: no disputed payment created this morning (Disputed tile 1; sidebar open disputes 6), no direct debits that would still be pending (bank rails are customer-sent ACH, Wire, SEPA, Bacs), the failed SEPA debit is a declined card; tiles 2,259 + 61 + 1 + 38 + 59 = 2,418

Names: Mira Okafor (MO) is Celeste Arnaud (CA); replaced colliding customers Calder & Voss, Tidewell, Kovač, Juniper & Pell, Halvard, Brightwater, Quarry Lane, Fenwick, Harrowfield, Northbank, Norrell and Corlett; empty frame names Penwarden Hotels

owner.said: I love the B2B product screens; they look absolutely crazy

rework.audited_by: fresh-context agent (did not build it), then a second fresh agent verified the fixes

references.what: Two total cards, filter dropdowns, selected rows with a 'Pay selected' total; ours is quieter and its data more specific
Plain summary strip and muted cents; ours adds work queues and the reference, match and invoice columns
Bank reconciliation one statement line at a time; ours handles the queue in one table with a side panel for one receipt

rework.too_close: No: compared with Stripe's Transactions page, ours shares none of its tiles, chips, buttons, column order or ID format; the only shared patterns (a plain summary strip, a floating dark bulk bar) appear in many products
changed: The screen is now Receipts: incoming customer payments matched to invoices (cash application), the job a wholesale supplier's finance team does all day; Quoin is a receivables product

Six Stripe-order count tiles replaced by four money figures as plain text (Received, Matched to invoices with a meter, Waiting to match, Held as credit) and work-queue tabs in working order: To match 192, Held as credit 63, Matched 2,163, All 2,418; the main frame opens on To match

States the business really has: Suggested (quiet), Part payment (quiet), Short with the amount, 2 sets fit, No match (the only amber, 3 of 16 visible rows); payers who are not customers shown by the bank's payer name

One Filter button plus the filter in force, chip values in ink, Match rules instead of Edit columns, Import bank file and Record receipt instead of Export and Create payment, a bank-feed freshness stamp
Columns: Received, Customer, Their reference (raw bank text), Paid by (ACH, Wire, Check, SEPA credit, Bacs, FPS), Amount, Match, Invoice, Receipt; IDs RC-412917 and TR-256379 instead of qpy_3N...
Bulk bar: 3 selected $21,162.82 USD, Confirm matches, Hold as credit, Assign...

Second frame shot-match.png (?state=match) replaces the Edit columns frame: the match panel for a $12,960.00 ACH that two sets of invoices fit, with the oldest-first pick, a tally and a save-as-rule option; shot-columns.png moved to the macOS Trash
Empty frame: nothing to match for Penwarden Hotels, figures follow the filter, one action

Consistent rates: period Oct 1-14 (10 working days, about 250 receipts a day), receipt numbers at that rate, invoices about 230 a working day, ACH at Federal Reserve settlement times (08:30, 13:00 ET)
Waiting to match raised to $311,482.09 so it covers its own rows ($148,599.49 for the 19 in the table); Matched lowered to $2,492,802.73 (87.6%)

Real names replaced: Whitlock Inn, Hotel De Zwaluw BV, Ravintola Saaristo Oy and Ravensworth Inns Ltd are now Thackery Inn, Hotel Brakelduin BV, Ravintola Kuusiluoto Oy and Haddleby Inns Ltd; references 4410 and 4471 shared with other pieces changed; NAMES.md updated (22 unused names removed, 6 added)
Dark mode: the bulk bar's secondary text, icons and dividers and the workspace mark now use text.inverse mixed into bg.inverse (sum 5.4:1 in dark, was 1.14:1)
